speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: Who mends thy shirts in London?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A woman at the lodging, when I ask her. Often I do not ask.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: Then they are not mended. Thy right forefinger is dyed. Thy father's were dyed with alum the same.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Ink, mother. Not alum. The shop is his. This is a pen.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: It is the same finger. Come in. I will not speak of what you do.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Sit where you sat. Thy father is not come, and the pew will not discuss it. Eyes front when we are in.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: If nobody is to look at the empty place, I will not look at it. I am applying the rule from the door, so it is already kept.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Then keep it, and keep it quietly. The ribbon stays at home. So does the sword. Sit.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: I left it on the nail. I counted the nail. One nail. I am only saying I know where it is.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: You have said where it is. Mother asked for sitting, not for a count.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sit by thy mother, both of you. The count can wait on a school day.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: God keep this house, and the bread, and the hands.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Eyes front, Susanna.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: I had not turned. I was only finding the place in the book.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Find it, then. There is nothing else to find.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: The grace was short. Short is allowed, if it is the same one as at home. I am not asking for the rest of it.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: You will not have the rest of it. It is said.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: The bench is hard, and that is a fact, not a request to leave.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The bench can bear a psalm. We are not a procession.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am where she put me. I have not improved it.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: That will do for the morning. You came in on my arm. That is the part I asked.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: And nobody made a speech of the other part. Keep it so until we are out.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: The place in the book is found. I have nothing further to report about the pew.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Then neither have I. The rule has survived one psalm. I call that a test.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: The nail is still the fact I am keeping. I can keep it without saying it again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep it, then. We are not done until she stands.
